source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: Q&A | Answering Questions You're Afraid to Ask

lines.en: What are your thoughts on dating apps?
lines.zh: 你對交友軟體有什麼看法？

lines.en: Have you ever been part of the hookup culture?
lines.zh: 你有參與過約炮文化嗎？

lines.en: How to get over guys who give you mixed signals?
lines.zh: 遇到給你曖昧不明訊號的男生，要怎麼放下？

lines.en: How is it really co-parenting with your ex?
lines.zh: 和前任共同教養孩子，真實情況是怎樣？

lines.en: Today, I'm going to be volunteering to be your unnie.
lines.zh: 今天我要自告奮勇當你們的歐尼（姊姊）。

lines.en: I've definitely put on some mileage in my life, so I feel like I've got some input.
lines.zh: 我的人生確實累積了不少里程，所以我覺得自己能給點意見。

lines.en: Oh lord, there's so much about dating.
lines.zh: 天啊，關於約會的事太多了。

lines.en: Okay, we're just going to come in hot.
lines.zh: 好，我們就直接火力全開吧。

lines.en: What are your thoughts on dating apps?
lines.zh: 你對交友軟體有什麼看法？

lines.en: To this day, I have not used a dating app.
lines.zh: 到今天為止，我從來沒用過交友軟體。

lines.en: It's not like Like I don't have an aversion towards it.
lines.zh: 並不是說我排斥它。

lines.en: Like I think for some people it works.
lines.zh: 我覺得對有些人來說是有用的。

lines.en: Like my cousin found her husband on Hinge. How sick is that? And we love him. What's up, Steve?
lines.zh: 像我表姊就是在 Hinge 上找到她老公的。是不是超酷？而且我們很喜歡他。嗨，Steve！

lines.en: You know, I do think that your soulmate could potentially be on there.
lines.zh: 你知道，我的確覺得你的靈魂伴侶有可能就在上面。

lines.en: But I prefer meeting people the good old-fashioned way in real life.
lines.zh: 但我比較喜歡用老派的方式，在現實生活中認識人。

lines.en: Uh either like through mutual friends or maybe we're at a party or like out and about somewhere.
lines.zh: 呃，像是透過共同朋友，或是在派對上，或是在外面某個地方。

lines.en: But preferably through mutual friends because that way there's already a referral.
lines.zh: 但最好是透過共同朋友，因為這樣就已經有人推薦了。

lines.en: Like it's not just a random.
lines.zh: 就不是隨便一個陌生人。

lines.en: Does anyone else not wash their face with soap in the morning? It's already clean.
lines.zh: 還有人早上洗臉不用洗面乳的嗎？臉本來就很乾淨了。

lines.en: I'm just removing the creams off my face.
lines.zh: 我只是把臉上的乳霜洗掉而已。

lines.en: I also don't really enjoy the process of just like thumbing through men's dating profiles and examining like photographs of men. It's very strange.
lines.zh: 我也不太喜歡一直滑男生的交友檔案、研究男生照片的過程。很奇怪。

lines.en: I think this might be a hot take, but I think most men do not photograph well.
lines.zh: 這可能是個爭議性的看法，但我覺得大多數男生都不上相。

lines.en: And if you do, that means you're part of this category where you're just so unbelievably attractive that every photo looks great or it means you've spent some time and practice taking good photos.
lines.zh: 如果你很上相，那就代表你屬於那種帥到不可思議、每張照片都好看的類型，或者代表你花了不少時間練習拍好照片。

lines.en: And for some reason I just find that just emasculating.
lines.zh: 不知道為什麼，我就是覺得那有點不夠男子氣概。

lines.en: I know, it's it's it's unfair.
lines.zh: 我知道，這、這、這很不公平。

lines.en: I realize that I'm the problem because this is just This is just what online dating is like.
lines.zh: 我知道問題出在我身上，因為線上交友本來就是這樣。

lines.en: It's part of the system.
lines.zh: 這是整個機制的一部分。

lines.en: So, I would rather just remove myself from that process as and meet people out in the field.
lines.zh: 所以我寧願讓自己退出那個過程，到現實中認識人。

lines.en: Because I think like once I meet someone in real life, then their like digital persona I I don't really care because I know the person in real life.
lines.zh: 因為我覺得一旦我在現實生活中認識一個人，他們在網路上的形象我就、我就不太在乎了，因為我認識的是真實的他。

lines.en: Like biologically. Have you ever been part of the hookup culture?
lines.zh: 就是生物本能上的感覺。你有參與過約炮文化嗎？

lines.en: Every once in a blue moon, there's like a part of me that thinks you know what, that could be a little interesting.
lines.zh: 偶爾，非常偶爾，我心裡會有一部分覺得：你知道嗎，那可能會有點有趣。

lines.en: But if I am so for real with myself, I know that that would be a nightmare.
lines.zh: 但如果我對自己完全誠實，我知道那會是一場惡夢。

lines.en: Like a one-night stand, god, the the anxiety I would feel after.
lines.zh: 像一夜情，天啊，事後我會有多焦慮。

lines.en: It's just not worth it.
lines.zh: 就是不值得。

lines.en: At this point in my life, like it's just it's just not for me.
lines.zh: 在人生的這個階段，那就、那就不適合我。

lines.en: It just It just can't.
lines.zh: 就是、就是不行。

lines.en: There's just too much on the line.
lines.zh: 要承擔的風險太大了。

lines.en: But I really have nothing against people who are able to get their physical needs met without the emotional side.
lines.zh: 但我真的不反對那些能夠滿足生理需求、卻不牽扯情感的人。

lines.en: But yeah, just something that I never was able to do.
lines.zh: 但對，那就是我從來做不到的事。

lines.en: Like I'm very quick to have a conversation with you and we can talk about everything, but when you're crossing that physical line, man, there's It's like a maze.
lines.zh: 我很快就能和你聊開，我們什麼都能聊，但一旦要跨過身體那條線，天啊，就像走迷宮一樣。

lines.en: It's like a corn maze with levels.
lines.zh: 就像一座有好幾層關卡的玉米迷宮。

lines.en: When do you know your relationship is not fixable and you have to end it?
lines.zh: 你怎麼知道一段感情已經無法挽回、必須結束？

lines.en: This question is heavy because everyone's end point is different, but there's like a few telltale signs.
lines.zh: 這個問題很沉重，因為每個人的底線都不一樣，但有幾個明顯的徵兆。

lines.en: The main one is if you find yourself mutating into a version of yourself that you don't like.
lines.zh: 最主要的一個，是你發現自己變成了一個你不喜歡的樣子。

lines.en: Every person that you interact with, they activate a different part of you.
lines.zh: 你接觸的每一個人，都會激發出你不同的一面。

lines.en: And if your partner is making you more irritable and cranky, if life feels heavier and more impossible when they're with you, like the writing's kind of on the walls.
lines.zh: 如果你的伴侶讓你變得更易怒、更暴躁，如果他們在你身邊時，生活感覺更沉重、更不可能，那結局大概已經寫在牆上了。

lines.en: I mean I feel like this could be a result of just layers of resentment piled on top of each other.
lines.zh: 我是說，我覺得這可能是一層又一層的怨恨堆疊起來的結果。

lines.en: And I think it's fixable as long as both parties are willing to roll up the sleeves and do the work.
lines.zh: 我覺得只要雙方都願意捲起袖子好好努力，還是可以修補的。

lines.en: But even if one person doesn't want to participate, then the relationship is toast.
lines.zh: 但只要有一方不想參與，這段感情就完蛋了。

lines.en: All right, makeup is done. This question's hilarious.
lines.zh: 好，妝化好了。這個問題太好笑了。

lines.en: Someone asked, "Help, my boyfriend's mom literally has everything.
lines.zh: 有人問：「救命，我男朋友的媽媽真的什麼都有。

lines.en: I know Christmas is months away, but as a fellow Virgo, I must impress."
lines.zh: 我知道聖誕節還有好幾個月，但身為處女座的同類，我一定要讓她留下好印象。」

lines.en: First of all, I feel this so hard.
lines.zh: 首先，我超懂這種感覺。

lines.en: But when in doubt, I always unwrap the holidays with the Google Holiday 100.
lines.zh: 但拿不定主意的時候，我總是用 Google Holiday 100 來拆開節日的禮物清單。

lines.en: Huge thank you to Google for sponsoring this portion of the video and shoutout to Warby Parker, too.
lines.zh: 非常感謝 Google 贊助這段影片，也要感謝 Warby Parker。

lines.en: The Google Holiday 100 is a curated list of the year's most searched gift ideas.
lines.zh: Google Holiday 100 是一份精選清單，收錄了今年搜尋次數最多的禮物點子。

lines.en: So that way you know you're buying something that people actually want.
lines.zh: 這樣你就知道你買的是大家真正想要的東西。

lines.en: And if you're buying any last-minute gifts, use the nearby feature.
lines.zh: 如果你要買最後一刻的禮物，可以用「附近」功能。

lines.en: So that way you can find hard-to-find gifts in places that are local to you.
lines.zh: 這樣就能在你附近的店家找到難找的禮物。

lines.en: Like these Elio sunglasses from Warby Parker. They're the perfect gift.
lines.zh: 像是 Warby Parker 的這副 Elio 太陽眼鏡，是完美的禮物。

lines.en: Check out the scalloped edge, the little rivet detail.
lines.zh: 看看這扇形的鏡框邊緣、小小的鉚釘細節。

lines.en: They're just so timeless, so chic.
lines.zh: 就是這麼經典、這麼有型。

lines.en: Plus, they're scratch resistant, so you can just throw them in your purse and take them anywhere. These are $95.
lines.zh: 而且它們抗刮，所以你可以直接丟進包包、帶去任何地方。這副 95 美元。

lines.en: They're great quality and they work on anyone.
lines.zh: 品質很好，而且誰戴都好看。

lines.en: Whether it's your boyfriend's mom, your best friend, even you.
lines.zh: 不管是男朋友的媽媽、你最好的朋友，甚至是你自己。

lines.en: And the best part is I didn't need to overthink it because the Google Holiday 100 list has the top searches of all the best gifts, so they're always going to hit.
lines.zh: 最棒的是我不用想太多，因為 Google Holiday 100 清單列出了最熱門的禮物搜尋，所以一定會送到心坎裡。

lines.en: So whether you're the friend who shops early or you're the one panic buying during Christmas Eve, just ask Google.
lines.zh: 所以不管你是提早買禮物的那種朋友，還是平安夜才恐慌搶購的人，問 Google 就對了。

lines.en: Check out the Google Holiday 100.
lines.zh: 去看看 Google Holiday 100。

lines.en: I'll leave a link in my description box.
lines.zh: 我會把連結放在說明欄。

lines.en: That way you can just kickstart your seasonal shopping or just get some ideas.
lines.zh: 這樣你就可以開始準備季節性的購物，或只是找些點子。

lines.en: Shoutout to Google Shopping for helping me discover the top gifts of the year and to Warby Parker for the perfect sunglasses.
lines.zh: 感謝 Google 購物幫我找到今年最熱門的禮物，也謝謝 Warby Parker 提供完美的太陽眼鏡。

lines.en: Now let's get back to more of your questions.
lines.zh: 好，我們回到你們的問題。

lines.en: All right, let's make a quick little matcha.
lines.zh: 好，我們來快速做一杯抹茶。

lines.en: There is something kind of funky I do with my matcha.
lines.zh: 我做抹茶有個有點怪的習慣。

lines.en: I add this Brainwash supplement.
lines.zh: 我會加這個 Brainwash 保健品。

lines.en: It's basically got It's like a nootropic.
lines.zh: 它基本上是、是一種益智補充品。

lines.en: There's a bunch of mushrooms that are supposed to enhance like cognitive performance. Does it work?
lines.zh: 裡面有一堆蘑菇，據說可以提升認知表現。有用嗎？

lines.en: I I'd like to think so.
lines.zh: 我、我希望有吧。

lines.en: It basically makes my matcha uh more chocolatey.
lines.zh: 它基本上讓我的抹茶，呃，更有巧克力味。

lines.en: So I just add a pack of this. Oof. Some ice, milk.
lines.zh: 所以我就加一包。喔。加點冰塊、牛奶。

lines.en: So this is a drink that I have every day.
lines.zh: 這是我每天都會喝的飲料。

lines.en: I stopped drinking coffee at home maybe I want to say like for like 2 months.
lines.zh: 我在家不喝咖啡大概，我想說大概兩個月了。

lines.en: It's only because I started to get a bunch of acid reflux.
lines.zh: 只是因為我開始常常胃食道逆流。

lines.en: This is why I decided to choose matcha.
lines.zh: 所以我才決定改喝抹茶。

lines.en: It tastes like chocolate milk that's a little bit more earthy.
lines.zh: 喝起來像是多了一點土壤味的巧克力牛奶。

lines.en: How to get over guys who give you mixed signals?
lines.zh: 遇到給你曖昧不明訊號的男生，要怎麼放下？

lines.en: I cannot stand mixed signals.
lines.zh: 我受不了曖昧不明的訊號。

lines.en: As someone who has a lot of anxiety, I like certainty.
lines.zh: 身為一個很容易焦慮的人，我喜歡確定的事。

lines.en: All I'll say is if someone genuinely likes you, it will be clear.
lines.zh: 我只想說，如果一個人是真心喜歡你，那會很明顯。

lines.en: It will be abundantly clear that they like you.
lines.zh: 他喜歡你這件事會非常非常明顯。

lines.en: When you text them, they respond back at a reasonable hour.
lines.zh: 你傳訊息給他，他會在合理的時間內回覆。

lines.en: If you want to make plans with them, they give you dates.
lines.zh: 你想跟他約，他會給你日期。

lines.en: In fact, they want to make plans with you.
lines.zh: 事實上，他會主動想跟你約。

lines.en: Like there's not all of this mumbo jumbo gray zone area when someone likes you.
lines.zh: 當一個人喜歡你的時候，不會有那麼多模稜兩可的灰色地帶。

lines.en: So if you're interacting with someone who's giving you mixed signals, chances are they are not like willing to double down on you or maybe they're weighing out other options.
lines.zh: 所以如果你正在跟一個給你曖昧訊號的人來往，很可能他並不願意在你身上加碼投入，或是他還在比較其他選擇。

lines.en: Either way, they're not sure about how they feel about you.
lines.zh: 不管是哪一種，他都不確定自己對你的感覺。

lines.en: So if I had to give you like a time limit, I'd say 4 weeks.
lines.zh: 所以如果要我給一個期限，我會說四週。

lines.en: That's just shy of a month of your life.
lines.zh: 就是不到一個月的人生。

lines.en: It's long enough to give them a chance to get their together to see if they are vibing with you or not, but you're not wasting too much time where you're wasting your life.
lines.zh: 這段時間夠長，可以給他機會整理好自己、看看你們合不合得來，但又不會浪費太多時間、浪費你的人生。

lines.en: Also, the people that give you mixed signals tend to stick out in your mind more because they're doing this thing called intermittent positive reinforcement.
lines.zh: 還有，給你曖昧訊號的人往往更容易讓你念念不忘，因為他們在做一件叫「間歇性正增強」的事。

lines.en: Basically, your brain gets addicted to how unpredictable it all is.
lines.zh: 基本上，你的大腦會對那種無法預測的感覺上癮。

lines.en: It's like when you're playing the slot machines, you just keep hitting the slots and maybe you'll get some change back.
lines.zh: 就像玩吃角子老虎機，你一直拉，說不定會吐一點零錢回來。

lines.en: The same concept goes to someone that gives you mixed signals.
lines.zh: 給你曖昧訊號的人也是同樣的道理。

lines.en: Like you spend most of your time overthinking every little thing and wondering like does this person even like me?
lines.zh: 你會花大部分的時間過度解讀每一件小事，想著：這個人到底喜不喜歡我？

lines.en: And then when you finally get that text back or they finally give you like a little tiny spurt of attention, it's like a little bit of a dopamine rise that just keeps you coming for more.
lines.zh: 然後當你終於收到回覆，或他終於給你一點點關注時，就像多巴胺小小地上升一下，讓你一直想要更多。

lines.en: But for me, I am quick to cut my losses when someone's giving me mixed signals.
lines.zh: 但對我來說，當有人給我曖昧訊號時，我會很快停損。

lines.en: Like if you want to be with me, you got to be 10 toes down.
lines.zh: 如果你想跟我在一起，就要十根腳趾都踩穩在地上。

lines.en: Like I don't want a pinky toe up, they all have to be down.
lines.zh: 我不要有任何一根小指頭翹起來，全部都要踩下去。

lines.en: And that's what I want for you.
lines.zh: 這也是我希望你得到的。

lines.en: I am currently going through a divorce.
lines.zh: 我正在辦離婚。

lines.en: Any tips on how to cope and emerge stronger?
lines.zh: 有什麼建議能幫我撐過去、變得更堅強？

lines.en: I think it's fair to say that divorce sucks for everyone.
lines.zh: 我想可以說，離婚對每個人來說都很痛苦。

lines.en: It's like a universal experience that is terrible for everyone involved.
lines.zh: 這幾乎是一種普遍的經驗，對所有相關的人都很糟。

lines.en: Like even if you don't hate your ex, it still sucks.
lines.zh: 就算你不恨你的前任，還是很痛苦。

lines.en: Keeps me going is knowing that there's the finish line and the like the feelings of like grief and the feelings of being overwhelmed, they come in waves and so you just have to let it pass.
lines.zh: 讓我撐下去的，是知道終點線就在那裡，而那些悲傷、那些被壓垮的感覺會一波一波地來，你只能讓它過去。

lines.en: How did you know you wanted to be a mom?
lines.zh: 你是怎麼知道自己想當媽媽的？

lines.en: I feel like there was no point in my life where I was like, "All right, I'm ready to be a mom now.
lines.zh: 我覺得我人生中從來沒有一個時刻是：「好，我準備好當媽媽了。

lines.en: Like let's try for a baby."
lines.zh: 我們來生個寶寶吧。」

lines.en: The choice was sprung up on me. It was 2020.
lines.zh: 這個選擇是突然落到我頭上的。那是 2020 年。

lines.en: Uh my period was late.
lines.zh: 呃，我的月經遲到了。

lines.en: Peed on a stick and then I found out I was pregnant.
lines.zh: 我驗了孕，然後發現自己懷孕了。

lines.en: I was freaked out, shocked.
lines.zh: 我嚇壞了，很震驚。

lines.en: In the end, I decided to become a mom because I felt like I would have more regrets if I didn't go along with the pregnancy.
lines.zh: 最後我決定當媽媽，因為我覺得如果不繼續這次懷孕，我會更後悔。

lines.en: And thank god I did.
lines.zh: 感謝老天我這麼做了。

lines.en: I'll be the first to say that children are not for everyone.
lines.zh: 我會第一個說，孩子不是適合每個人的。

lines.en: Like it is it is challenging.
lines.zh: 它、它真的很有挑戰性。

lines.en: But having my son has been truly the most transformative thing that has ever happened to me.
lines.zh: 但生下兒子，真的是我人生中發生過最具改變力量的事。

lines.en: If life were Sims, when my son arrived, it's like the expansion pack came.
lines.zh: 如果人生是模擬市民，兒子出生就像是資料片來了。

lines.en: I was already like a pretty emotional person, but being a parent made everything like 10 times more intense and richer.
lines.zh: 我本來就是個情緒滿豐富的人，但當了父母讓一切都強烈、豐富了大概十倍。

lines.en: It's like everything became very visceral.
lines.zh: 一切都變得非常發自肺腑。

lines.en: Like the the sorrow and the the anxiety and the and the sadness you feel being a parent, it feels like a tidal wave is just flattening you.
lines.zh: 當父母時感受到的哀傷、焦慮和難過，就像一波海嘯把你壓扁。

lines.en: But when you are happy, it feels like you're just soaring off a mountain and it's just it's transcendent.
lines.zh: 但當你快樂的時候，就像從山上飛躍而起，那是一種超脫的感覺。

lines.en: It it's it's so hard to put in words.
lines.zh: 那、那、那真的很難用言語形容。

lines.en: So, it's just like for every part that is hard, there is something that is equally as rewarding.
lines.zh: 所以就是，每一個辛苦的部分，都有同樣值得的回報。

lines.en: So, it's just a matter of like do you want your life to be more intense?
lines.zh: 所以問題只在於：你想要你的人生更強烈嗎？

lines.en: Like do you want to feel alive? Have a kid.
lines.zh: 你想感覺自己真正活著嗎？那就生個孩子吧。

lines.en: Each year of motherhood feels like I'm like part of this insane workout regime.
lines.zh: 當媽媽的每一年，都像在參加一套瘋狂的健身課表。

lines.en: Like every day I am like challenged, I'm sore, but like I see my muscles growing.
lines.zh: 每天都被挑戰、全身痠痛，但我看得到肌肉在長。

lines.en: And that's just what parenthood does for you in like the self-development sense.
lines.zh: 就自我成長來說，當父母就是會帶給你這些。

lines.en: It's just a roller coaster.
lines.zh: 它就是一趟雲霄飛車。

lines.en: So, if you if So, if you're looking to go on a ride and you can find a partner that is willing to do it with you, I'd say strap in.
lines.zh: 所以如果、如果你想搭上這趟旅程，而且能找到願意和你一起搭的伴侶，那我會說：繫好安全帶吧。

lines.en: How is it really co-parenting with your ex?
lines.zh: 和前任共同教養孩子，真實情況是怎樣？

lines.en: Co-parenting has definitely been a learning curve because this is our first time doing this.
lines.zh: 共同教養絕對是一段學習的過程，因為這是我們第一次這麼做。

lines.en: It's also our first time being parents, so it's all a first colliding.
lines.zh: 這也是我們第一次當父母，所以所有的「第一次」都撞在一起了。

lines.en: But, truthfully, I'm really proud of the way me and Ben have handled all of this.
lines.zh: 但老實說，我真的很自豪我和 Ben 處理這一切的方式。

lines.en: Like even though we're not romantically together, like we will always be a family. Period.
lines.zh: 就算我們不再是情侶，我們永遠都會是一家人。就這樣。

lines.en: Like I actually have trouble calling him my ex.
lines.zh: 其實我很難把他叫做我的前任。

lines.en: I never refer to him as my ex.
lines.zh: 我從來不說他是我的前任。

lines.en: I always call him like Lennon's dad or the father of my child.
lines.zh: 我總是叫他 Lennon 的爸爸，或是我孩子的父親。

lines.en: I know that title sounds really serious and formal, but it's because it is.
lines.zh: 我知道這個稱呼聽起來很嚴肅、很正式，但那是因為它本來就是。

lines.en: Like the like the weight is warranted in that title.
lines.zh: 這個稱呼的份量是理所當然的。

lines.en: Like this man is the father of my child.
lines.zh: 這個男人是我孩子的父親。

lines.en: Because when you have a baby with someone, that person becomes your relative.
lines.zh: 因為當你和一個人生了孩子，那個人就成了你的親人。

lines.en: So, I think there's always going to be like a foundation of mutual respect.
lines.zh: 所以我想我們之間永遠會有互相尊重的基礎。

lines.en: His well-being is important, my well-being is important, because if we're not good, then our son's not good.
lines.zh: 他過得好很重要，我過得好也很重要，因為如果我們不好，我們的兒子也不會好。

lines.en: So, I think like co-parenting is really it's all about communication and adjusting when needed.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得共同教養真的就是靠溝通，還有在需要時做調整。

lines.en: And so, the biggest game changer that has happened is us doing this monthly co-parenting meeting.
lines.zh: 而最大的改變關鍵，是我們每個月開一次共同教養會議。

lines.en: This is where we talk all things about our son.
lines.zh: 我們在會議上談所有關於兒子的事。

lines.en: There's updates, there's school stuff, there's scheduling, there's his interests, there's behavior that we notice that's great and not so great.
lines.zh: 有近況更新、學校的事、行程安排、他的興趣，還有我們注意到的好行為和不太好的行為。

lines.en: And so, this is where we can kind of tweak and adjust things.
lines.zh: 所以我們可以在這裡稍微微調、修正一些事情。

lines.en: These meetings have been so helpful because it creates cohesion between both households.
lines.zh: 這些會議非常有幫助，因為它讓兩個家之間保持一致。

lines.en: We fill out this template on Notion and it's just incredible.
lines.zh: 我們用 Notion 上的這個範本填寫，真的很棒。

lines.en: Like honestly, gotta give me and Ben a pat on our backs.
lines.zh: 老實說，真的要給我和 Ben 拍拍肩膀、稱讚一下。

lines.en: Like even if you're not co-parenting, this template could help.
lines.zh: 就算你不是在共同教養，這個範本也可能有幫助。

lines.en: How do you maintain a sense of youthfulness even when life forces you to adult really hard? Hmm.
lines.zh: 當生活逼得你不得不非常努力當個大人時，要怎麼保有年輕的感覺？嗯。

lines.en: The key to always feeling young is to be able to be excited about the little things.
lines.zh: 永遠覺得年輕的關鍵，是能為小事感到興奮。

lines.en: Like when I notice my son and like other kids, they're just so stoked on anything and everything.
lines.zh: 像我觀察我兒子和其他小孩，他們對任何事都超級興奮。

lines.en: Like it could be like the fact like we're getting gelato.
lines.zh: 可能只是因為我們要去吃義式冰淇淋。

lines.en: Or like we're at a park and he notices a school friend, he's like like he loses his mind.
lines.zh: 或是我們在公園，他看到一個學校的朋友，就整個瘋掉了。

lines.en: And I think it's that pure enthusiasm that keeps them so young.
lines.zh: 我覺得就是那種純粹的熱情，讓他們保持年輕。

lines.en: And I feel like that's something that a lot of adults tend to lose.
lines.zh: 而我覺得那是很多大人往往會失去的東西。

lines.en: I feel like some grown-ups don't give themselves permission to be happy unless it's like a big moment.
lines.zh: 我覺得有些大人不允許自己快樂，除非是遇到什麼大事。

lines.en: You can't be happy unless you're on vacation or if you got a promotion or you got engaged.
lines.zh: 除非你在度假、升職或訂婚，否則你不能快樂。

lines.en: And these milestones are moments to be celebrated, but they're not sustainable.
lines.zh: 這些里程碑是值得慶祝的時刻，但它們無法持續。

lines.en: You like you're not going to be doing this type of stuff every day.
lines.zh: 你不會每天都在做這種事。

lines.en: So, I think it's about letting yourself get excited for the little things.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得重點是讓自己為小事感到興奮。

lines.en: Like like your wacky matcha chocolate drink.
lines.zh: 像是你那杯古怪的抹茶巧克力飲料。

lines.en: Like I am genuinely thrilled to drink this every day. Fresh laundry. An organized drawer.
lines.zh: 我真的每天喝它都很開心。剛洗好的衣服。整理好的抽屜。

lines.en: Phone call with a friend. I don't know.
lines.zh: 和朋友講一通電話。我也不知道。

lines.en: It's just like these small little things are the ones that are going to keep you afloat in this sea of dread.
lines.zh: 就是這些小小的事，會讓你在一片令人沮喪的大海裡保持漂浮。

lines.en: It's the tiny things like the daily delights that are going to like keep you hovering from depression. All right.
lines.zh: 就是這些微小的事，像是每天的小確幸，讓你不會沉進憂鬱裡。好。

lines.en: Well, I think I'm going to end it here.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想就到這裡結束吧。

lines.en: Thank you for spending the morning with me.
lines.zh: 謝謝你們陪我度過這個早上。

lines.en: I'm going to go pick up my son and I'll see you guys in the next one. Bye.
lines.zh: 我要去接兒子了，我們下一支影片見。掰。
